Locators are printed page numbers (PAGE | n footer; equal to PDF pages). A market and policy monitor focused on buildings; almost all quantitative content is in dashboard charts without printed values. Main file (4 technologies, 5 process contexts): industrial heat pump temperature milestones (120 degC demonstrated ~2022; >160 degC commercial by 2027), the 200 MW Qianxi absorption heat pump on steel-mill waste heat, and the 15/18-year lifetimes assumed for air-to-air and air-to-water building heat pumps in the levelised-cost comparison. _other-values.csv: relative capex (about 10x a gas boiler, 3x a coal boiler), COP competitiveness thresholds, levelised cost of industrial heat read approximately from the p.13 chart (China and EU; flagged read from chart), deployment statistics, temperature-band potential assumptions. Not extracted: buildings sales, manufacturing, trade, employment, patents, refrigerant and policy dashboards. No industrial heat pump capex per kW, COP by temperature lift, or lifetime is printed: the to-get need (industrial heat pump cost and COP detail) is not met.
